basic_info.description: Fantastic opportunity for the savvy buyer. Large 1,650 square foot, 3 bedroom, 1.5 bath condo in the heart of NOPA. This updated Edwardian condo has updated features mixed with original details and is the middle unit in a well maintained 3-unit building. 3 well-sized bedrooms and 1.5 updated baths complete this large unit featuring an in-unit washer and dryer, as well as an updated kitchen. 1-car garage parking (available for use in the common area garage,) as well as a shared backyard space complete this classic San Francisco condo. Located in the heart of trendy NOPA, the neighborhood features leafy residential streets and hip restaurants and locales, making this condo the perfect San Francisco locale.
